title: Meta-loop auto-drain hot-spins in host mode (container-not-active every 2s)
description: With meta_loop=auto and worker_isolation=host, the sidecar auto-drain refuses every ~2s with reason container-not-active, spamming the event log and console (kind:meta-loop-dispatch, refused:true). Observed 2026-07-07 during CAM-201 host-mode operation. Expected: no-op quietly or back off when worker_isolation != container, not a tight 2s refuse-loop. Low priority.
